requirement: Implement StructuredMarkupParser wrapping BeautifulSoup with explicit parser feature configuration ('lxml-xml' for XML and 'lxml' for HTML), preventing parser guessing warnings, preserving case-sensitive XML tag hierarchies, properly parsing self-closing non-HTML tags, and extracting CDATA section content without entity distortion.
skeleton: StructuredMarkupParser class with __init__, parse, and extract_tag_values using bs4.BeautifulSoup and bs4.CData.

rationale.teaches: BeautifulSoup with an explicit parser feature per mode, case-preserving XML tag lookup, CDATA text extracted verbatim, and a validated mode.
rationale.why: Letting BeautifulSoup guess the parser warns and lowercases XML tags, so case-sensitive lookups silently return nothing. The fixture uses mixed-case tags and CDATA containing angle brackets.

candidates.why_wrong: XML mode uses the HTML parser, so tag names are lowercased and self-closing tags are mangled.
No parser feature is passed, so BeautifulSoup guesses, warns, and may lowercase tags.
Tag lookups are lowercased, so mixed-case XML tags are never found.
Angle brackets are stripped from CDATA text, so markup inside CDATA is corrupted.
An unknown mode is accepted and falls through to the HTML parser.
